Description.Name: Murdock
Description.Details: Murdock Banacek is proficient in all forms of flying vehicles and 'Mechs. Passing his Trial of Position as a Star Commander, Murdock's obsession with being airborne soon had him taking any opportunity to get into the cockpit of anything that could lift him off the ground. He was involved in multiple Trials of Grievance when his un-clanlike methods and combat preferences would ultimately insult another ranking clansman.
